0.description: Fixed an issue where you could not Bloodforge items from setis with the bloody jar!
Added Clarification to the Tooltips of the Temporal Contracts for Dungeons & Raids. You can mouse over their new description after clearing your cache.
Fixed an issue where the Temporal Contract: "Proving Grounds" would not complete your quest. Patch Update is required.
Fixed an issue that occured within the past 24 hours with the Blackblade of Shahram that caused it to no longer give the Haste Proc on the weapon.
Added the Capital City & Faction Specific PvP Vendors for Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin & Alterac Valley to Booty Bay!
Homogenized the costs of Honor Gear for the Horde & Alliance PVP sets. This means that Horde Gear will no longer cost more than alliance gear.

6.description: Bosses should no longer be affected by Fortified in Mythic+

0.description: [Al'ar]' World Bosses no longer drop epic items - instead, the chance to obtain world boss & epic items from your Treasures of Azeroth has been MASSIVELY increased.
[Al'ar]' World Bosses now drop 250 Marks of Ascension, 10 Mystic Orbs, 3 Mystic Runes.
Fixed an issue where bartleby could not be attacked.
Increased your chance to find Dusk Shards when disenchanting.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Increased the damage of Drain Life by 10%.

8.description: Honorable Combat: High-Risk quests now properly require 3 player kills instead of 10. (pending restart)

1.description: [Pending Restart] Increased the base healing of Flash of Light by 10%.
[Pending Restart] Casting Call Pet when you don't have a Pet will no longer give invalid error message.
[Pending Restart] You can no longer cast Revive Pet when you don't have a Pet.
[Pending Restart] You can no longer cast Tame Beast if you already have a pet.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Corrected an issue that caused Secret of the Farstriders to give increased scaling to Arcane Shot. It will now give 12% as intended.

0.description: [Pending Restart] Players that are in a dungeon will now also log back into this instance when the server was restarted - instead of getting ported to the instance entrance location.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where players would sometimes lose their personal instance binds.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where players would receive reputation loss with the renown faction after a duel.
Fixed an issue where Auctionhouse was not showing stacks of items you had listed.
Added the base for Ameer Greatluck. Over the next few days he will have options added to allow you recover items and characters!
All Beastmaster Whistles, Summoner Stones, and Blood Soaked Vellums are now classified as Pet Cosmetics in the Vanity Collection.

6.description: [Stratholme] Ramstein the Gorger is now temporary the final boss of Stratholme and required to be slain to complete Mythic Keystone Dungeons on the Service Side instead of Baron Rivendare.

7.description: Guerilla Trapper now also reduces the range of Concussive Shot by 10 yards. If you get pulled from Guerilla Trapper, you can't be pulled again for 10 seconds. [Pending restart]

1.description: Serpent Sting now deals 10% more damage. [Pending restart]

0.description: [Area-52] Swift Nether Drake should now always be usable at low levels, inside battlegrounds and not only inside of outlands. This will now also scale with your riding speed.
[Area-52] Fixed an issue where sometimes Dragon's Breath could not be used despite being off cooldown.
Increased the amount of items obtained within the Prestigious Cache.
Fixed an issue where Heart of the Scale from Overlord Wyrmthalak had too low of drop chance.
Fixed over 1,200 items that could not be Bloodforged with the Bloody Jar, namely, many honor pvp pieces.
Added Callboards nearby Faction Leaders.
All quests that could previously only be turned into the faction leader NPCs can now be turned in at the callboard as well.
All Quest Givers and Quest Turn-in NPCs equal or below level 20 will now be un-attackable.

Pending Restart - Scroll of Retreat: {Stormwind/Orgrimmar} will no longer trigger a 12 hour cooldown for the Stone of Retreat: {Stormwind/Orgrimmar}. Using the Scroll of Retreat used to put the Stone of Retreat on a 12 hour cooldown.
Fixed an issue where Dusk till Dawn [Epic Mystic Enchantment] could sometimes hit more than 5 targets with its AoE effect.
fixed an issue where the last boss of Arcatraz could drop no loot.
2v2 Solo Queue is now available on Al'ar!
2v2 Solo Queue is now available on Area 52!

Commanding Shout now lasts for 30 minutes, changed from 5. [Pending restart]
Battle Shout now lasts for 30 minutes, changed from 5. [Pending restart]
